description: Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 260/22 of 02.09.1983 published under the Coast Conservation Regulations No. 1 of 1982
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to regulations under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act, No. 57 of 1981. It focuses on legal/regulatory matters including fee structures for permits, environmental impact assessments, and various coastal zone activities. While it mentions the President and Minister who made the regulation, this is standard legal citation format rather than the primary focus, which is regulatory amendments and fee schedules. The content primarily deals with legal framework modifications rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
